# Lake Victoria household malaria survey (synthetic)

A cross-sectional malaria survey in ten villages near Lake Victoria, western
Kenya, run in April and May 2023. In each village we enrolled one or two
households and every household member who consented. At enrolment we recorded
demographics, bednet use the previous night, recent fever, weight and height.
Each participant gave a finger-prick blood sample for a malaria rapid
diagnostic test and a HemoCue haemoglobin reading, and axillary temperature was
taken at the same time. A few participants gave a second sample at a follow-up
visit in mid-May.

Files: `villages.csv`, `households.csv`, `participants.csv`, `samples.csv`,
plus `data-dictionary.md`. Village coordinates are the village centre in
decimal degrees. Participant names are included for our records only and must
not be published.

This dataset is synthetic. It was written by hand as a test fixture for the
tabular-to-stf skill.
